verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing exposes a broad API for creating/managing cards, balances, authorizations, and transaction rules, but the docs explicitly call out several actions that require the Customer Area UI rather than the API (e.g., configuring relayed authorisation webhooks 'Log in to your Customer Area', viewing card payments in the Customer Area, and uploading dispute evidence as a zip via Customer Area as a pilot feature), showing real UI-only gaps. missing for 10: confirmation that webhook configuration, payment viewing, and dispute file upload can be done purely via API, plus a published OpenAPI spec (probe found none) to verify full parity.
